note: NOT ground truth. Each entry records a value and the ECS field that value IS. The ladder may read this file; it may never read truth.json. See validators/v3_5_known_values.py.
provenance: Derived from samples.ndjson by bench/make_known_values.py, using the per-family extractor in corpus/heldout_scenarios.py for the keys and truth.json for the key -> ECS field map. These are the same lines V3 feeds the sandbox, so V3.5 can find them. NOT an independent observation: unlike the synthesised corpus, where the generator injected these values, here the field each value belongs to comes from the labelling. V3.5 on this source is therefore a consistency check rather than a probe. It still detects a value the parser dropped, which is what it is needed for.
